item.title: Britain through the ages: Post-war reinvention
item.description: THIS documentary by Brendan Walker explores how scientific breakthroughs transformed post-war Britain in the 1950s. From nylon stockings to vinyl records, the petrochemical industry fuelled a revolutionary shift in lifestyles, transforming fashion, music, and everyday life and creating a pronounced cultural generation gap.
